import secrets
import msal


def start_oauth_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    url = app.get_authorization_request_url(config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'], state=state)
    return {'authorization_url': url, 'session_id': state}

import msal


def oauth_callback(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    result = app.acquire_token_by_authorization_code(
        payload['code'], scopes=config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'])
    return result

import msal
import secrets


def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.PublicClientApplication(config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}")
    code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    code_challenge = app.create_code_challenge(code_verifier)
    url = app.get_authorization_request_url(config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'], state=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
        code_challenge=code_challenge, code_challenge_method='S256')
    return {'authorization_url': url, 'code_verifier': code_verifier}

import boto3


def store_audit_record(record):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table('FederatedLoginAudit')
    table.put_item(Item=record)
